The '''slungerhound''' was a half-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall beast used as pets and for security. After a large number of attacks against [[Human/Legends|Humans]]&mdash;twenty percent of which were against their own owners&mdash;the beasts were banned on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].
